items.headline: Task force reviewed draft Station Area plan, crossing study
items.summary: The October 15 Station Area Task Force agenda included a public hearing on the Benton-Brokaw Multimodal Crossing Feasibility Study and a review of the complete draft Station Area Specific Plan.

items.headline: Ten new single-family homes permitted on Aldeia Drive
items.summary: San José issued building permits for ten new single-family homes on Aldeia Dr (addresses 2 through 14), with declared permit valuations ranging from about $424,925 to $641,692 across the various house plans. The same-day batch of permits points to a new residential subdivision being built out on the street.

items.headline: Council holds closed-session interviews for new city attorney
items.summary: The October 10 agenda listed a closed session for City Council to interview candidates for the City Attorney position.

items.headline: Council holds second day of city attorney interviews
items.summary: The October 9 agenda listed another closed session for City Council to interview candidates for the City Attorney position, continuing the process from the prior day.

items.headline: Council to address city attorney transition, manager's pay
items.summary: The October 6 city council agenda listed discussion of temporary legal services during a city attorney transition, compensation changes for unrepresented management and confidential employees, and a market-based pay adjustment for the city manager.
